name: tavernweave-yuri
description: Create original yuri roleplay cards or adapt existing cards, posts and novel excerpts while preserving source records and unrelated settings.

interface.longDescription: Four yuri creation/adaptation workflows with the pinned TavernWeave authoring and source-library dependencies. The host supplies file tools, Python, Node, search and images when available.
defaultPrompt: 帮我通过对话创作一张百合角色卡，未指定的细节由你决定。
把这张 JSON 或 PNG 卡改编成百合故事，保留无关设置。
从这段帖子或小说片段制作百合角色卡，保留来源记录。
